exposure: type of delivery (natural childbirth and cesarean section)
cohort: 254 women who referred to Afzalipour Hospital for delivery
finding: Mothers who delivered via cesarean section had lower LATCH scores, indicating poorer breastfeeding performance, compared to those who had a natural childbirth.
mod_finding: Mothers who delivered via cesarean section had lower LATCH scores, indicating poorer breastfeeding performance, compared to those who had a natural childbirth.
